changelog.summary:
- Introduced new CSS styles for spell target confirmation, enhancing visual feedback during spell selection.
- Updated spell definitions and mechanics to reflect changes in the "grim" spell, now renamed to "幽魂" with adjusted effects.
- Refactored game logic to support new random spell selection mechanics, improving user interaction during gameplay.
- Enhanced treasure mechanics to include new functionality for managing treasure multipliers, enriching the overall game experience.

- Updated README.md to include clickable links for Shadertoy and LICENSE, enhancing accessibility.
- Added a new CSS variable for player mark accent color to improve UI consistency.
- Refactored button styles to utilize the new accent color, enhancing visual feedback during gameplay.
- Improved overall CSS styles for better responsiveness and user experience.

- Added a new probability display feature for treasures, allowing the display of doubled probabilities when the "打字机" treasure is owned.
- Updated treasure descriptions and definitions to reflect changes in probability mechanics, ensuring clarity in gameplay.
- Introduced new utility functions for managing treasure probabilities and their effects on gameplay.
- Refactored related components to integrate the new probability features, enhancing user experience and interaction.
- Improved CSS styles for better visual feedback related to treasure mechanics.

- Removed outdated versioning instructions from README.md for clarity.
- Added a post-commit script to automatically update the changelog summary based on commit messages.
- Enhanced changelog entry handling in appVersion.js to replace placeholders with default summaries.
- Updated appVersion.json with the latest changelog entries reflecting recent changes.
- Improved commit message parsing functionality in changelog-from-commit.mjs for better integration.

- Bumped version to 0.0.1 and added automated versioning scripts for minor and major updates.
- Introduced an AboutLayer component to provide game information and changelog access.
- Updated MainMenu to include an option for opening the About section.
- Enhanced CSS styles for improved visual feedback and responsiveness across components.
- Refactored game mechanics to support new features and streamline user interactions.
初始公开版本；含关于弹窗与自动版本机制。
